help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:273  Is the scheduled archive actually working? Plus what the local harness
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:274  scanner finds (read-only).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:275  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:276  The first line answers the question the timer cannot: it reads the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:277  `run-state.json` written by the last `run-once` pass. Three distinct
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:278  answers, and only the first is a healthy one:
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:279  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:280  * last run recent and successful -> exit 0
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:281  * last run FAILED -> exit 1, saying which step failed
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:282  * no run recorded at all, or nothing has run for longer than
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:283    4x `backup_interval_secs` (minimum 1 hour) -> exit 1. A dead timer
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:284    usually leaves a *successful* last run behind, so this overdue check
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:285    is the only thing that catches it.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:286  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:287  Never prints session content: counts, timestamps and digests only.

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:292  machine holds three sessions or three thousand, so the verdict never

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:302  Print exactly one JSON object to stdout and nothing else (the

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:305  `{"kind":"not_applicable",…}` — an unknown is never serialised as
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:306  `0`, `null` or a missing field. `run_state.kind` is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:307  `known` / `missing` / `unreadable`; `scanner.kind` is `ok` /
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:308  `failed`. `exit_semantics` documents what the exit code means.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:312  Dump one session back from the repository (sequence-concatenated) and
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:313  print its sha256 for verification — or, with `--all-machines`, merge

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:316  Stage directory used by push (mapping into the snapshot tree).

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:404  Keep the ssh ControlMaster processes open after this run (do not shut them down).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:408  Initialise a new destination as a *full extra copy* (ADR-013).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:409  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:410  Order is fixed: re-collect from the local sources first (they are the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:411  truth, and rereading them puts no load on an existing destination),
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:412  then copy back only what an existing destination holds and the local
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:413  source no longer does, then push the result. The new destination ends
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:414  up with `local ∪ existing destinations`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:415  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:416  A source destination that cannot be consulted makes the difference set
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:417  *incomplete*: that is reported and the command exits non-zero. It is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:418  never treated as "that destination had nothing extra".
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:420  Destination to initialise. Must be declared in the config, unless
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:421  an explicit `--repo` is given instead.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:424  Stage directory that holds the sealed `sessions/` tree.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:427  Machine partition for `sessions/<machine>/…`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:430  Maximum sealed shards per bucket (default: 20).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:433  Existing destination to compute the difference set against,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:434  repeatable. Default: every other destination in the config.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:437  Repository path override for the destination being initialised.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:440  Masterkey file override for the destination being initialised.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:443  Concurrency cap override.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:446  Backend option `key=value`, repeatable.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:449  Keep the ssh ControlMaster processes open after this run (do not shut them down).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:452  Record this destination's ssh host key in `~/.ssh/known_hosts` after
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:453  printing its fingerprint. Off by default and never implied: without
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:454  this flag nothing is ever written to `known_hosts`, so the first
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:455  connection of an unattended run cannot silently trust a host.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:459  Search one destination's archive by session metadata.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:460  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:461  Metadata tier only: this walks snapshot/index/tree objects plus each
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:462  machine's small activity index, and never fetches or decrypts a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:463  session's conversation shard, which is why it is cheap. On a local
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:464  three-session fixture the metadata walk read 11,761 bytes against
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:465  1,206,285 bytes of data packs — two orders of magnitude apart. Use
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:466  `--cost` to see what a full-text pass over the current hits *would*
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:467  cost before asking for one; full-text matching is not implemented.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:468  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:469  One destination per run, always named: there is no automatic merge
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:470  across destinations, and no default destination to search "everything".
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:471  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:472  The time window filters on the **conversation's own activity interval**,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:473  not on when the backup ran: a session matches when `[first message,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:474  last message]` intersects the window. Those times come from the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:475  `activity-index` sidecar (`meta/<machine>/activity-v1.jsonl`) carried in
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:476  the archive, so `--day 2026-01-15` finds a conversation held that day
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:477  even if the machine was last pushed months later.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:478  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:479  A session whose conversation time is unknown is **never silently
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:480  excluded**. It is listed separately with the reason, and while a time
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:481  window is active it does not count as a match — which also means a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:482  "0 matched" answer cannot be trusted while any remain, so the exit code
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:483  is `3` rather than `1`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:484  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:485  Exit codes distinguish the three answers, because two of them look the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:486  same and mean opposite things: `0` matched something, `1` read the whole
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:487  destination and answered for every session and nothing matched, `3`
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:488  could not finish — either reading it, or placing every session in time —
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:489  so "nothing matched" is unproven. `2` is a usage error, as elsewhere.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:491  Destination to search. Required unless an explicit `--repo` is given.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:494  The shared filters (session / machine / harness / time window).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:497  Emit one JSON object on stdout instead of the human report. The
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:498  three groups (matched / not matched / could not be placed) stay
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:499  separate fields, so a consumer cannot read an unknown as an absence.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:502  Also report what a full-text pass over the hits would cost.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:505  Repository path override.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:508  Masterkey file override.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:511  Concurrency cap override.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:514  Backend option `key=value`, repeatable.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:517  Keep the ssh ControlMaster processes open after this run (do not shut them down).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:521  Write every session the shared selector selects to files.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:522  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:523  One destination per run, always named, exactly like `search` — and the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:524  selection is literally the same code path: `export` writes the sessions
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:525  `search` returns for the same flags, so `search` is the dry run of this
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:526  command with a different name, and `--dry-run` prints the same price
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:527  `search --cost` reports before anything is fetched.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:528  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:529  Layout: `<out>/<machine>/<harness>/<session-id>.jsonl`, each file holding
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:530  that session's archived lines in their native format, byte-identical to
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:531  what `read` returns for it. Plus `<out>/manifest.json`: per session its
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:532  machine, harness, id, first and last message time, shard count, bytes
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:533  written, sha256 of the written file and the filters that were applied —
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:534  and, at the top level, the sessions no filter could place, the machines
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:535  whose activity index could not be read, the sessions that could not be
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:536  written, and the exit status this run returns.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:537  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:538  `--turns user` keeps only the lines that are the user's own messages.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:539  That is answerable only where the harness's format makes it certain (see
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:540  `export::USER_TURNS_HARNESSES`); elsewhere every line is written and the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:541  session records `turns_filter: "not-supported"`. The flag is never
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:542  silently ignored and content is never silently dropped.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:543  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:544  `--trim-to-window` drops lines whose own timestamp is outside
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:545  `--day`/`--since`/`--until`. A line whose timestamp cannot be read is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:546  kept and counted in `untimed_lines`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:547  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:548  `--out` must be empty or absent unless `--force` is given. Nothing is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:549  ever deleted, and nothing is ever written outside `--out`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:550  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:551  Exit codes, the same family `search` uses: `0` wrote at least one
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:552  session and answered every session the query touched · `1` read the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:553  whole destination and selected nothing · `3` did not finish — part of
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:554  the archive was unreadable, a session could not be placed, or a selected
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:555  session could not be written — so the output on disk is real but
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:556  incomplete, and the manifest says what is missing · `2` usage error.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:558  Destination to export from. Required unless an explicit `--repo` is given.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:561  Directory to write into. Must be empty or absent unless `--force`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:564  The shared filters (session / machine / harness / time window).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:567  Which lines to write: `all` (default), or `user` for only the user's
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:568  own messages — kept only for harnesses whose format makes that
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:569  certain; for any other harness every line is written and the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:570  manifest records `turns_filter: "not-supported"`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:573  With a time window, also drop lines whose own timestamp lies outside
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:574  it. Lines whose time cannot be read are kept and counted in the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:575  manifest's `untimed_lines`. Requires a window.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:578  Write into a non-empty `--out`. Nothing is ever deleted, so files
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:579  from an earlier export stay where they are.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:582  Print the plan and stop: no directory is created and no file is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:583  written.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:586  Repository path override.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:589  Masterkey file override.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:592  Concurrency cap override.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:595  Backend option `key=value`, repeatable.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:598  Keep the ssh ControlMaster processes open after this run (do not shut them down).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:602  Open the archive dashboard in a browser: totals, the machine × source
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:603  matrix, a weekly activity heatmap, and drill-down into any cell.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:604  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:605  Binds a short-lived HTTP server on `127.0.0.1` with an OS-assigned port
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:606  (never `0.0.0.0`, never a fixed port), prints the URL, optionally opens
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:607  your browser, and exits when idle or on Ctrl+C. Nothing is installed:
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:608  no launchd, no systemd, no background process, no resident daemon.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:609  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:610  THREAT, stated plainly: loopback is NOT a security boundary. Every other
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:611  program running on this machine can connect to `127.0.0.1`, so this is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:612  not "safe because it's local". Access is gated by a random token that is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:613  generated fresh on every launch and appears only in the printed URL —
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:614  never in a file, never in a log. Requests without that exact token are
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:615  refused (403), and any method other than GET is refused (405). Treat the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:616  URL as a secret for the lifetime of the process.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:617  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:618  Metadata tier: the dashboard and every list are rendered from one read of
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:619  snapshot + index + tree metadata plus the activity sidecar. Conversation
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:620  text is fetched and decrypted only when you click a session and then
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:621  click "load", and the byte cost is printed before you do. Exit codes
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:622  match `search`: 0 served the dashboard, 1 read it all and there was
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:623  nothing, 3 could not finish reading (or no key), 2 usage error.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:625  Deprecated alias for `ui`; prints a one-line notice on stderr and behaves
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:626  identically. Kept for one release.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:628  Consume ext inbox bundles into sealed staging shards.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:629

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:634  bytes are never archived twice. Prints paths/counts/sha256 only.

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:651  Read every scanner session returned by `status` into our own stage.

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:654  durable byte offset plus committed-prefix SHA-256; opencode SQLite
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:655  sessions use a durable logical high-water cursor. The cursor state lives
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:656  under chat-stasher's own data directory, not under any harness directory.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:657  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:658  Exit codes: 0 = every recognised session was archivable and was

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:661  line), so what was written is real but incomplete; 1 = the pass failed
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:662  (collect itself errored, or individual sources could not be read).

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:672  Maximum sealed shards per bucket (default: 20).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:675  Named destination from the config. Read state is kept per
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:676  destination, so a different destination is a different debt set.

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:683  Masterkey file override for the destination above.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:687  Seal one file already inside our stage into the next sealed-shard slot.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:688  This command never renames a harness-owned path.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:689

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:696  data.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:698  Registry harness id that owns the active file (e.g. `claude-code`).

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:705  Stage directory that holds the sealed `sessions/` tree.

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:713  Session id to seal into. Default: the active file's stem.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:716  Maximum sealed shards per bucket (default: 20).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:720  Reclaim the sealed shard body from the staging tree, but only where the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:721  archive provably holds every byte (ADR-020 Phase 4).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:722  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:723  The stage is an unbounded local full copy; nothing ever shrinks it.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:724  This command retires the shard body once every declared destination
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:725  proves it holds each session. Proof means asking the archive itself —
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:726  never the local cursor — for every session's digest triple (shard
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:727  count / concatenated bytes / concatenated sha256) and matching it
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:728  against the stage. A destination that cannot be consulted is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:729  "unproven" and blocks the reclaim: it is never treated as "does not
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:730  have it". Every declared destination must prove it holds each session,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:731  or
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:732  nothing is deleted.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:733  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:734  Default is a dry run that reports what would be reclaimed and deletes
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:735  nothing; pass `--apply` to actually remove the body. `--apply` writes
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:736  each machine's retained summaries first, then deletes session by
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:737  session, keeping each session's persistent `shard-seq` counter so the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:738  next sequence never falls back onto archived shard names.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:739  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:740  Exit codes: 0 = reclaimable (dry run) or reclaimed (apply); 1 =
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:741  blocked — at least one destination is unreachable, partial, or fails
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:742  to hold a session, so nothing was deleted; 2 = usage error.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:744  Stage directory that holds the sealed `sessions/` tree.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:747  Actually delete the proven shard body. Default: dry run (report only).

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:766  Register this executable as the browsers' Native Messaging host
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:767  (ADR-014 step 2) — or, with `--uninstall`, remove that registration.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:768  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:769  ADR-014 exists because `chrome.downloads` with `saveAs: false` is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:770  overridden by the browser-level "ask where to save each file before
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:771  downloading" preference, which no extension flag can suppress. At up to
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:772  200 backfilled conversations a day that is 200 modal dialogs.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:773  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:774  This is one command instead of the five physical actions Native
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:775  Messaging otherwise costs: it renders the host manifest (`name` /
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:776  `description` / the absolute `path` of *this* executable / `type:
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:777  stdio` / the pinned extension allowlist) and drops it into each
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:778  installed browser's discovery directory. No elevation: everything is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:779  per-user.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:780  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:781  Every path written, left alone, skipped or removed is printed
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:782  absolutely. "No error" is not the same claim as "a file landed".
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:783  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:784  Idempotent: run it twice and there is exactly one manifest per browser,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:785  byte-identical, exit 0 both times. Exit codes: 0 = at least one manifest
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:786  is in place (or, for `--uninstall`, removal finished), 3 = nothing was
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:787  written because no known browser was found, 2 = usage error (bad host
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:788  name / extension id / relative binary path), 1 = an action failed.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:790  Browser to register with, repeatable. Default: every browser whose
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:791  data directory exists on this machine. Naming one explicitly writes
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:792  it even when that directory is absent.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:795  Discovery root override (macOS default: `~/Library/Application
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:796  Support`). This is what makes the command testable without writing
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:797  into a real browser directory.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:800  Which OS path layout to use. Default: this platform.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:803  Host binary recorded in the manifest. Default: this executable
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:804  (`std::env::current_exe()`), which is the only value that stays
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:805  correct after `cargo install --force`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:808  Host name override. Chromium's grammar is `[a-z0-9_.]` only.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:811  Chrome/Chromium/Edge/Brave/Vivaldi extension id.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:814  Firefox add-on id (`browser_specific_settings.gecko.id`).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:817  Remove the manifests this command writes — and nothing else.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:820  Windows only: skip the `reg.exe` step and only write the JSON.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:823  Stage the browser-spawned host is allowed to write to. Recorded in
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:824  the config as `[native_host] stage`. The directory must already
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:825  exist and be a directory: the host never creates a stage, and a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:826  stage that appears because a host was pointed at it is a stage
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:827  nothing pushes. The edit preserves the config file's comments and
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:828  everything else in it.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:832  The Native Messaging host process itself.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:833  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:834  Runs the same one-request-one-response loop the browser launch uses:
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:835  reads one length-prefixed request frame from stdin, writes one response
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:836  frame to stdout, exits 0. Useful for driving the host by hand before any
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:837  browser is involved. Each process serves exactly one request — the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:838  browser starts one process per message, and the host is built for that.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:839  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:840  Nothing but that one frame may ever reach stdout: Chromium reads stdout
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:841  as a `u32` frame length, so a stray log line is read as a multi-gigabyte
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:842  frame and kills the pipe. Diagnostics go to stderr. A frame that ends
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:843  early (EOF inside the length prefix or the body) is answered with
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:844  silence and a non-zero exit, never with a response.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:845  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:846  `--self-test` prints one line of JSON on stdout and exits 0, unchanged:
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:847  it answers "does the host process start at all?" without needing a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:848  request.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:850  Print one line of JSON describing this host, then exit 0.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:854  Build the activity sidecar index for one machine partition (ADR-017).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:855  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:856  Walks `<stage>/sessions/<machine>/<session>/<bucket>/NNNNNN.jsonl`,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:857  concatenates each session's shards in global sequence order, and feeds
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:858  every line through the conversation-time extractor to produce one
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:859  `ActivityRow` per session. The rows are written as JSONL to
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:860  `<stage>/meta/<machine>/activity-v1.jsonl` — the file the `overview`
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:861  command reads back out of a destination.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:862  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:863  The harness label is inferred from the session directory name: the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:864  canonical archived ids are `<source>.<machine>.<native-id>`, so the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:865  harness is the leading dot-segment (`claude-code.<m>.<uuid>` ->
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:866  `claude-code`); short forms are handled too (`opencode~abc123` ->
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:867  `opencode`, `cursor.d~xxx` -> `cursor`).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:868  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:869  Metadata only: the extraction keeps a timestamp per line and throws the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:870  line away. Nothing else about a conversation is ever read, kept or
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:871  printed — the report is counts and the output path only.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:872  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:873  Exit codes: `0` = the whole partition was read and the index written;
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:874  `3` = the stage could not be read (or reading was interrupted) — nothing
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:875  (complete) was written; `1` = every session was read but the index file
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:876  itself could not be written; `2` = usage error. Same family as
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:877  `collect`/`search`: `3` means "did not finish / never started", `1`
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:878  means "finished and then failed".
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:880  Stage directory that holds the sealed `sessions/` tree.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:883  Machine partition for `sessions/<machine>/…`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:884  Default: config `machine`, else this machine's identity (generated
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:885  on first use); use `--machine` explicitly to choose the partition.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:889  Write this machine's display-name declaration (ADR-018).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:890  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:891  Writes `<stage>/meta/<machine>/machine.json` — a `MachineDeclaration`
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:892  that carries the human display name, the OS and a first-seen time. The
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:893  machine partition is resolved exactly like every other command: config
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:894  `machine` first, then the identity file (generated when missing). The
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:895  next `push` archives the whole stage root, so this file rides along.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:896  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:897  The display name is taken from `--display-name` when given; otherwise
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:898  the system's LocalHostName (`scutil --get LocalHostName` on macOS,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:899  `hostname` elsewhere) is used. If neither is available the field is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:900  written **empty** and the command says so — a name is never invented.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:901  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:902  Exit codes: `0` = the declaration was written; `3` = the machine
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:903  partition could not be resolved or the identity is unusable; `1` = the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:904  file could not be written; `2` = usage error.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:906  Stage directory to write the declaration into (`<stage>/meta/…`).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:909  Human display name for this machine. Default: system LocalHostName.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:913  Give a dead or sold machine a display name (ADR-018).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:914  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:915  Writes `<stage>/meta/<target>/label-by-<local-identity>.json` — a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:916  `LabelRecord` expressing *this* machine's opinion about what `<target>`
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:917  should be called. It exists for machines that can no longer declare for
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:918  themselves (sold, dead, in a different building). Each file has exactly
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:919  one writer, so concurrent machines never fight over it; the overview
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:920  shows the label with the latest `written_at_unix`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:921  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:922  Exit codes: `0` = the label was written; `3` = the local identity could
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:923  not be resolved; `1` = the file could not be written; `2` = usage error.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:925  Stage directory to write the label into (`<stage>/meta/…`).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:928  Machine id (partition) being labelled, e.g. a 32-hex identity.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:931  Display-name override for the target.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:935  Draw the machine × harness activity overview of one destination
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:936  (ADR-017).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:937  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:938  Opens the destination repository, takes each host's newest snapshot
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:939  (the same cross-machine merge as `read --all-machines`), and for every
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:940  snapshot recursively finds the activity index files at
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:941  `meta/<machine>/activity-v1.jsonl`. The paths carry each machine's own
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:942  absolute stage prefix, so they are matched by the trailing
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:943  `meta` / `<machine>` / `activity-v1.jsonl` marker — never by a local
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:944  path. The indexes are parsed into overview rows and rendered as a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:945  machine × harness matrix, a time-unknown tally and a width-adaptive
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:946  heatmap. Prints counts, machine names and time spans only — never
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:947  conversation content.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:948  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:949  A machine that has a snapshot but **no** activity index is listed
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:950  explicitly as "index missing" — it never vanishes silently, because a missing
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:951  index is not the same thing as "that machine had no sessions".
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:952  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:953  Exit codes: `0` = at least one index was read and rendered; `1` = the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:954  whole repository was read and there is no activity index at all (a real
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:955  "there is none", not a failure to look); `3` = the repository could not
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:956  be read in full (open / snapshot / tree / dump failure) — the absences
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:957  below are unproven; `2` = usage error.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:959  Destination to open. Required unless an explicit `--repo` is given:
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:960  there is no default destination.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:963  Terminal width for the matrix/heatmap (default: 100).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:966  Print exactly one JSON object to stdout and nothing else (the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:967  human matrix/heatmap is suppressed). Per-session `first_unix` /
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:968  `last_unix` and `time_source` are tri-state tagged
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:969  `{"kind":"known",…}` / `{"kind":"unknown","why":…}` — an unknown
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:970  time is never `null`. `no_index_anywhere` is `true` on exit 1
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:971  (read in full, no index anywhere); a failed read (exit 3) puts the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:972  reason in `error`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:975  Repository path override.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:978  Masterkey file override.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:981  Concurrency cap override.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:984  Backend option `key=value`, repeatable.
